summary: Frontend-only E2E test of Basket Tactics Motion (Italian PWA, canvas-based) via Playwright. Covered home navigation, new play dialog, editor (drag, tap->player panel, all 11 tools, linked move/pass auto-phase creation, animation playback & progress bar, undo/redo incl. Ctrl+Z, eraser), timeline (add/settings popover sliders/easing/move/duplicate/delete, speed cycle, next/prev/restart), court half/full, visibility toggles (desktop + mobile menu), editor menu (add players, PNG/sheet/JSON downloads, video recording -> MP4 1.5MB saved), library (16 presets, open copy), My plays (search, category filter, rename, duplicate, export single, delete, export-all, import backup + import single play JSON + invalid JSON error toast), autosave persistence after reload, /cerca?q=pick (both sections populated), settings persistence, PWA manifest/icons/sw registration, responsive iPhone portrait/landscape and iPad. No page errors observed. One real responsive bug found: toolbar overflow on iPhone portrait makes 4 tools unreachable.

ui_bugs.issue: Toolbar is 624px wide in a 390px viewport and can NOT be scrolled: the toolbar has `shrink-0` inside a flex row parent (`order-2 min-h-0 flex`), so it grows to content width and its own `overflow-x-auto` never activates (scrollWidth==clientWidth==624, setting scrollLeft stays 0). Parent overflow is visible and editor-page is overflow-hidden, so tools Zona, Area, Simbolo, Gomma (eraser) are cut off and unreachable on phones in portrait. Fix: in portrait make the toolbar shrinkable, e.g. replace `shrink-0` with `portrait:min-w-0 portrait:flex-1 landscape:shrink-0` (or add `w-full min-w-0` to toolbar / `min-w-0 w-full` to parent). Landscape (vertical toolbar) scrolls correctly.
Toolbar only 624px wide and left-aligned with an empty dark strip on the right (not full-width/centered). Cosmetic.
When removing the ball holder, ball falls back to `positions[id]?.x` AFTER `delete positions[id]`, so it is always x=7,y=7.5 instead of the removed player's position.

integration_issues.issue: Erasing a linked pass (o1->o3) or move arrow does not revert the derived state in the next phase (ball stays with o3 in phase 2; moved player stays at path end). The animation still happens without the line. Possibly intended, but confusing; consider reverting or informing the user.

issues: Switch OFF state is almost invisible (very dark track on dark card) - low contrast for setting-ghost / setting-lines / setting-loop
'Salva / condividi video' button label wraps onto two lines at desktop width
Copy says Chrome produces WebM but current Chrome produced MP4 (horns.mp4) - text slightly inaccurate
tool-hint banner (4.5s) and tool-options color/symbol bar overlay the court baseline/top area (pointer-events-none, so not blocking)
After a non-looping playback ends, timeline-progress stays at ~80% (holdStart of last phase) instead of 100%
'1 salvati sul dispositivo' - Italian singular/plural not handled ('1 salvato')
After selecting another category, previously focused 'Attacco' keeps a brownish highlight that looks semi-selected (focus style), may confuse which category is chosen

action_items: HIGH: Fix editor toolbar overflow in portrait phones so all 11 tools are reachable (horizontal scroll or wrap) - Editor.jsx parent div `order-2 min-h-0 flex` + Toolbar.jsx `shrink-0`
LOW: removePlayer ball fallback uses deleted position (model.js line ~136) - read position before delete
LOW: Improve switch OFF contrast in Settings; prevent wrap of 'Salva / condividi video'; fix '1 salvati' plural
Optional: decide behaviour when a linked move/pass drawing is erased (revert next phase state or notify)
critical_code_review_comments: Toolbar.jsx: `shrink-0` on a portrait horizontal toolbar defeats `overflow-x-auto` (root cause of HIGH bug).
Editor.jsx onPlayPause/onNext logic and phase move/delete bounds are properly guarded (buttons disabled at edges, deletePhase keeps >=1 phase).
Autosave is debounced 350ms with pagehide/visibilitychange flush - verified working.
seed_data_creation: Only browser localStorage in ephemeral Playwright contexts (TEST_ prefixed plays); nothing persisted server-side.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Canvas app: /app/tests/helpers.js injects window.__sp(playerId, phaseIdx) -> screen coords of a player (replicates court.js makeView), window.__play() -> current play from localStorage, window.__hash() -> canvas hash for change detection. Load with page.evaluate(open('/app/tests/helpers.js').read()) after navigating to /editor/:id. Clicking an ALREADY active phase chip opens the phase-settings popover which intercepts clicks - press Escape. Mobile dropdown menu stays open after toggling a visibility checkbox item - press Escape. Retest: iPhone portrait toolbar must allow reaching [data-testid=tool-eraser] (check toolbar clientWidth<=390 and scrollable). Not tested: editor-not-found route, settings-clear-btn, persist switch on drawings, real touch gestures.
